_doc: PERF s14: deck top resting (alt ~400 m) mist off/on; the gpu mem lines at Ultra near Rubolhin (1349x698 css, dpr 1).

shots.name: mem-ultra
script: await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: { kind: 'settlement', id: 1 }, dist: 80, tilt: 60, yaw: 0, fov: 55, hour: 11 }); await G.frames(6);
const t = await G.perfReport(4000); return { mem: t.split('\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('gpu mem') || l.startsWith('render targets')) };
